description: Branch R-FMT-2 Generated values (random AutoNumber and GUID generation) on an ACCDB, observation only. (1) AG(ID Long, G GUID) made through CreateTableDef with G's Attributes put to 16 (dbAutoIncrField) before append; three rows inserted without G and read. (2) CREATE TABLE with G UNIQUEIDENTIFIER DEFAULT GenGUID() and, separately, G GUID DEFAULT GenGUID(), then three inserts each. (3) AR(ID AutoNumber primary key, S): the field's property NewValues created as Text 'Random' and, as a second try, as Long 1, each appended with a marked Errors read, then five inserts and the IDs read. Asks which routes ACE admits and what each generates (the same GUID twice? a random Long?).
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
